name: Tsukahara
source:
A Curse Bearer who was one of the infamous "Thirteen Devil Children."

She dresses in a traditional kimono and apron, doing most of the chores as the household assistant. Like Ando, she was one of Matsuri's caretakers when she was still at the Benio Residence.

[From the [url=https://hanakimi.frontwing.co.jp/en/character14/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]The grandmother of [url=/c146475]Tsukahara Ao[/url].[/spoiler]
